notes: `מֵאָדָם רָע` writes no construct, so rule 29's count does not arise and the supplied *the* joins the noun's unit under rule 15, discontinuous around the adjective.

`מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים` → *from the violent man* is rendered attributively under rule 28 and the single supplied determiner is the construct noun's under rule 29, whichever English word stands first; the same division is taken at v.4 and v.11.
